categories.main_business_segments: Paylocity is a leading cloud-based provider of human capital management (HCM) and payroll software solutions. The company operates primarily through a single business segment delivering a comprehensive platform that includes payroll, HR, time and labor, talent management, benefits administration, and employee experience solutions. As of June 30, 2023, the company served approximately 36,200 clients across the United States with an average client size exceeding 140 employees.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages a cloud-based, multi-tenant architecture with a unified database and common code base developed organically. Key technological features include mobile-centric design principles, real-time web-based payroll processing, automated data integration with hundreds of third-party partner systems, AI-powered insights and recommendations through the Modern Workforce Index, and a modern, intuitive user interface. The platform supports complete employee lifecycle management from recruiting through compensation management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Paylocity serves mid-market organizations with 10 to 5,000 employees across diverse industries including business services, financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, restaurants, retail, and technology. The company targets organizations in the United States that require comprehensive HCM and payroll solutions. No single client accounted for more than 1% of revenues in any of the three years ended June 30, 2023.
categories.geographic_coverage: Paylocity operates primarily in the United States, with corporate headquarters in Schaumburg, Illinois, and major operations centers in Lake Mary, Florida and Meridian, Idaho. The company also maintains data centers in Franklin Park, Illinois and Kenosha, Wisconsin for backup and disaster recovery. The company has a global payroll solution enabling U.S.-based companies to manage payroll for employees outside the U.S., though primary operations are U.S.-focused.
categories.supply_chain_position: Paylocity operates in the midstream to downstream portion of the HCM and payroll services supply chain. The company provides software solutions and services directly to employers and their employees, integrating with upstream providers (401(k) advisors, benefits administrators, insurance brokers) and downstream service providers (banks for ACH processing, tax authorities). The company does not manufacture physical products but delivers cloud-based software services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Key strategic priorities include extending technological leadership through continued innovation in cloud-based solutions, growing the client base by targeting the 1.3 million U.S. businesses with 10 to 5,000 employees, expanding product offerings to increase per-employee spending, and developing the referral network of 401(k) advisors and benefits administrators. R&D investments focus on new modules, AI and machine learning capabilities, mobile applications, social features, analytics, and enhancing usability and functionality of existing solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Paylocity generates revenue primarily through recurring subscription fees based on the number of client employees and products purchased, supplemented by implementation fees for professional services. The company also earns interest income on funds held for clients in advance of payroll and tax remittances. Recurring and other revenue represented 93% of total revenues in fiscal 2023, while interest income on funds held for clients represented 7%. Annual revenue retention exceeded 92% in each of the past three fiscal years.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The HCM and payroll software market is fragmented and highly competitive. Primary competitors include Automatic Data Processing Inc., Ceridian HCM Holding Inc., Paychex Inc., Paycom Software Inc., Paycor Inc., Ultimate Kronos Group, and various local and regional providers. Paylocity competes on comprehensive single-platform solutions, ease of use, modern mobile-first design, cloud-based benefits, implementation speed, customer service quality, and integrated third-party ecosystem. Several competitors are larger with greater resources, though Paylocity emphasizes its modern architecture and user experience advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Paylocity is a large accelerated filer with significant scale and strong growth trajectory. Total revenues increased from $635.6 million in fiscal 2021 to $852.7 million in fiscal 2022 (34% growth) and to $1,174.6 million in fiscal 2023 (38% growth). Net income grew from $70.8 million in fiscal 2021 to $140.8 million in fiscal 2023. The company had approximately 6,100 employees as of June 30, 2023, and a market capitalization of approximately $8.2 billion as of December 31, 2022. Operating margins have expanded significantly with gross profit margin reaching 69% in fiscal 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Paylocity differentiates through a unified single-platform approach with flexible data architecture supporting the complete employee lifecycle, modern intuitive user experience designed for today's workforce including remote and hybrid workers, AI-powered insights and recommendations based on data from 36,200+ clients, seamless integration with hundreds of third-party partner systems reducing manual data transfer complexity, rapid implementation (typically one to eight weeks), and integrated implementation and client service organization. The company emphasizes employee engagement features, ease of use with limited training required, and delivering fast time-to-value for clients.
